sloka: अयम् राजा महाभाग गुरु शाप परिक्षतः ।स शरीरो दिवम् यातुम् न अर्हति एव तपो धन ॥१-६०-२५॥
transliteration: ayam rājā mahābhāga guru śāpa parikṣataḥ ।sa śarīro divam yātum na arhati eva tapo dhana ॥1-60-25॥

translations.english: "O Glorious maharshi, this king cursed by his spiritual preceptor is not worthy of going to heaven with his physical body".
